title: 'Find Your Dream House for Your Family' real estate post with oval photos and orange price tag
whatItIs: A square post with a blue wavy backdrop and topographic lines, a stacked headline where 'HOUSE' is huge condensed white and 'FOR' sits in an orange tag, two white-bordered oval and circle photos (modern house exterior, living room), a checklist of home features, an orange 'Started at $2,50000' price tag, 'Book now' pill and phone.
whatItMeans: Aspirational and informative; big type and a checklist sell both dream and facts.
techniques: Scale one word dramatically in a stacked headline.
Stack oval and circle photos with thick white borders.
Highlight price in a bold orange tag.

vocabulary.definition: Lines of different sizes stacked tightly.
